description: This file contains a JUnit test class for testing the KafkaPublisherActor in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.kafka package. It tests message publishing, header inclusion, and exception handling during Kafka message production.

classes.name: KafkaPublisherActorTest
classes.description: Unit test for KafkaPublisherActor, verifying message publishing, headers, and exception handling.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Sets up mock Kafka producer and connection factory for successful message sending.

methods.name: setUpMocksToFailWith
methods.description: Configures mocks to simulate exceptions during message sending.

methods.name: getPublisherActorProps
methods.description: Returns Props for KafkaPublisherActor with default configuration.

methods.name: getPublisherActorPropsWithDebugEnabled
methods.description: Returns Props for KafkaPublisherActor with debug enabled.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessage
methods.description: Verifies that a message was published with correct topic, key, payload, and headers.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessageToReplyTarget
methods.description: Verifies message publication to reply target with correct headers.

methods.name: verifyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks that acknowledgements have the expected status code and label.

methods.name: publisherCreated
methods.description: Confirms the publisher actor has been successfully created.

methods.name: getOutboundAddress
methods.description: Returns the predefined outbound address string.

methods.name: shouldContainHeader
methods.description: Helper method to verify headers contain specific key-value pair.

methods.name: testSendFailure
methods.description: Executes a test scenario with simulated sending failure and checks assertions.
